description: Developer view of a run: which failures the change likely caused and which it probably did not, with the reason.

ai.description: Use the AI layer for failures the rules cannot decide (default true; needs OPENAI_API_KEY).

dataset.description: Dataset directory relative to the Tewip repo, e.g. "data/real/gutenberg-holdout". Default: data/ (what the reporter collected). See list_datasets.

run.description: Run id or a unique part of it. Default: the latest run with failures.

name: pr_impact
title: Is this failure caused by the change?
